H9 rejected: edge/app ignores XFH; absolute URLs built from real host -> learned: www.shopify.com not susceptible to host-header poisoning via XFH
H11 rejected: marketing host sets no cookies at all -> learned: no cookie-tossing primitive from www.shopify.com
H13 rejected: values percent-encoded in transit; render surface behind bot challenge -> learned: locale chain is encoding-safe at every observable hop
